source.method: Read every source system and encode each written pitch, effective accidental, rest, onset and duration in a source ledger; separately transcribe ties, phrase slurs, beaming, staccato/accent markings, single-stroke tremolos, dynamics, rehearsal letters and final fermatas. Compare generated MusicXML events with this ledger.

corrections: Reconstructed from the source instead of retaining the baseline's 95 misnumbered measures; expanded the source multi-rests to 117 bars, consistent with the handwritten system-start measure numbers.
Restored the initial two bars of rest and all subsequent multi-rest durations for both clarinets.
Restored a full three-quarter measure in each staff/voice for every bar; retained explicit lower-staff tacet rests during the solo systems instead of hiding the second staff.

Re-read pitches and accidentals throughout, including the arpeggio in measure 47, solo material in measures 52-65, the two-clarinet eighth-note passage in measures 67-69 and the low G-sharp 3 in measure 85.
Encoded 11 single-stroke tremolos at measures 79-86, 87-88 and 92; removed the false OMR notes/durations derived from tremolo strokes.
Separated 52 same-pitch prolongation ties from 72 phrase slurs and paired every start/stop.
Restored the source beaming groups, articulations, rehearsal letters A-F, dynamics, solo/soli indications and final fermatas.
Declared B-flat transposition independently for both treble staves: diatonic -1, chromatic -2; preserved written pitches.

editorial_emendations.reason: The upper staff has the corresponding dotted-quarter figure, and the source is consistently in 3/4. The missing dot was also checked independently by the parent agent in the enlarged source crop.
editorial_emendations.documentation: MusicXML note footnote plus editorial level; source-ledger marks source and edited durations separately.

limitations: This is an assistant-led visual source transcription. The ledger comparison proves agreement with the encoded visual reading, not an independent human edition or an external critical source.
